composition_label: Ticket triage & routing -> Normal research -> Adaptive onboarding

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory using clearly labeled synthetic fixtures.

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version, synthetic, ticket, triage_config, corpus, research_config, profile, onboarding_catalog. example_input.json documents the full nested schema.
shared_schema.output: One envelope with schema_version, synthetic, status, ticket_id, triage, research, onboarding. Status advances triaged -> researched -> complete; future stages are null. CLI failures emit schema_version, status:error, error and exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: The shared Validator checks input at all stage boundaries, exact object fields, routing ownership, priorities, handoff consistency, exact extractive source spans, relevance, prerequisite ordering, profile preferences and citations.
shared_schema.citation: document_id, document_title, passage_index (zero-based), start/end (zero-based end-exclusive Unicode character offsets), quote. Findings extract entire passages without rewriting.
shared_schema.profile: experience is novice/intermediate/expert; preference is reading/hands_on.
shared_schema.configuration: Categories have keyword lists, baseline priority and team/owner routing. Priority rules escalate only. Research max_findings is 1..20. Step catalog declares categories, experience_levels, evidence_keywords, prerequisites and both content formats.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated ticket identity, category, priority, accountable team/owner and ticket/category-derived query terms are preserved. Query terms drive retrieval.
Validated category, ownership, findings and exact citations drive category/evidence selection. Selected evidence IDs and source citations are carried into the onboarding plan.

behavior.triage: Case-insensitive Unicode token matching, highest keyword count wins, configuration-order ties, configured default on no matches, most urgent matching priority or category baseline.
behavior.research: Ranks passages by distinct query-token overlap; zero-overlap passages excluded; ties use document ID then passage index. Returns up to max_findings exact full-passage extracts. Empty evidence is explicit.
behavior.onboarding: Selects category-compatible, experience-compatible steps supported by evidence keywords or marked as unconditional with an empty keyword list. Includes transitive prerequisites regardless of experience/category filters. Orders prerequisites first with stable catalog ordering and chooses preferred instruction format. Explains evidence, adaptation and prerequisite inclusion; no-evidence and empty plans are explicit.
behavior.optional_classifier: run_pipeline(data, classifier=None) accepts an optional Python callable receiving defensive copies of ticket and categories. It must return a configured category name; invalid output or exceptions produce ValidationError. Tests inject local fixtures only.
behavior.determinism: Pure deterministic rules, stable tie-breaking, no timestamps or randomness, defensive copies preserve caller data.

included: One sequential integrated pipeline and one shared validation boundary
Configurable categorization, escalation and accountable routing
In-memory lexical passage retrieval and exact extractive citations
Evidence-aware experience/preference adaptation and prerequisite closure
JSON CLI with structured validation and file errors
Synthetic standard-library unit and subprocess tests
excluded: Live models, network calls, external dependencies and external datasets
Production ticket queues, real refund submission and account operations
Semantic retrieval, generated synthesis and factual verification of corpus claims
Persistence, authentication, enterprise deployment and personalization learning

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status complete
cli.error_contract: Tests verify exit 2 and JSON status error for missing files, incorrect arguments, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, invalid schemas, non-finite constants and invalid UTF-8.
